text_block_list.text: One day, on the way home――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Aren't you lucky♪
I shall grant you the privilege of keeping first-class King company!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Isn't it supposed to be ""
here? Come now, you mustn't mix up your words.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, what now...?
You still have duties with your trainee left, don't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, paced running or practicing the King Call?
Which one do you prefer? I'll at least give you the right to choose.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a chant proclaiming my magnificence!
A non-stop chorus extolling my first-rate brilliance!

—Going along with something so utterly nonsensical
will surely be a grueling battle of mental fortitude...

A pace partner would benefit <chrname>, but――
if she runs now, I'm worried about her stamina.
choice_data_list: Let's practice the King Call, then.

text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up running
alongside King Halo...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Understood. Hehe, here I go~...! ...What is my name?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's King! That's where you're supposed to shout my name: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! No sighing allowed!
Put some more spirit into it!!
